top_choice_rationale: Sequencing by synthesis rests on a molecular-level chemical invention (reversible fluorescent terminator nucleotides, surface attachment, single-molecule detection of one incorporation per cycle), confirmed by independent laboratories for about two decades, with a compact Balasubramanian-Klenerman attribution inside the three-laureate limit. C-N coupling (P002) is equally mature but overlaps the 2010 framework; protein degradation (P001) has a sound ternary-complex mechanism but no approved degrader yet and a three-name split across two strands. Any award is preferred to none.
